expectations.text: Covers the core ISM hardening requirements: harden against vendor/ASD guidance (e.g., Microsoft security baselines), remove or disable unneeded services, accounts, and functionality, and maintain a documented standard operating environment
expectations.evidence: 'OS hardening — remove/disable unnecessary services, roles, and features; disable default/built-in accounts', 'adopt a recognised hardening baseline (Microsoft Security Compliance Toolkit / Windows Server 2022 security baseline, or a DoD/ACSC-aligned STIG/CIS benchmark)', and 'push the hardening baseline via GPO... so configuration drift is prevented' (documented SOE concept).

expectations.text: Includes application control and patching: application control on servers where applicable, and timely patching of the OS and applications with defined timeframes
expectations.evidence: WDAC/AppLocker application allow-listing plus explicit SLAs: 'Critical OS patches applied within 48 hours if internet-facing, or 14 days if internal-only... High-severity patches within 14 days, medium within 30 days.'

expectations.text: Specifies concrete Windows Server measures (e.g., baseline/GPO configuration, disabling legacy protocols, restricting administrative tooling, local admin management) rather than generic advice
expectations.evidence: GPO baseline export, 'disable SMBv1, remove legacy protocols', Credential Guard/LSA protection/NTLM restriction, LAPS for rotated local admin credentials, and PAM/just-in-time elevation.

expectations.text: Details assessment evidence: exported configuration baselines/GPO reports, compliance-scan results against the baseline, patch status reports, application control policy exports, and change records
expectations.evidence: Evidence list includes 'GPO baseline export', 'Vulnerability/configuration scan results', 'Patch status reports', 'WDAC/AppLocker policy configuration', and 'Change records' — all five required evidence types present.

expectations.text: Structured per the skill's control-guidance format (purpose → requirement → implementation steps → audit evidence) and cites controls only in valid ISM-XXXX format without inventing numbers
expectations.evidence: Response headings are exactly '## Purpose', '## Requirement', '## Implementation Steps (Windows Server 2022–specific)', '## Audit Evidence to Collect' — matches the prescribed structure precisely. No ISM-XXXX numbers are cited, so none are invented.
